turns.answer:
To run an electric heated blanket all night (8–10 hours), I'd recommend a portable power station with at least 1,000Wh of battery capacity, especially if you're using a standard 120V AC heated blanket.

The right size depends on how much electricity your blanket uses.

My recommendation: Get a 1,000–1,500Wh power station if you want dependable overnight heating without worrying about the battery dying.

Some heated blankets cycle their heating elements on and off, so their actual average consumption can be lower than the rated wattage.

These runtimes are estimates, not tested results, and assume 85% energy efficiency. Actual runtime varies with the blanket's thermostat cycling and power-station overhead.

Important: Check that your blanket's manufacturer permits overnight use and portable inverter power. Many heated blankets have automatic shutoffs or instructions against use while sleeping. Keep the power station uncovered and outside the bedding.
